summary: Removes the duplicate Auto clipboard fallback from daemon handle_worker_result, the now-unused inject::allows_clipboard_fallback helper, and its two tests. Intended behavior: Auto injection relies on inject::inject's backend order [paste?, wtype?, ydotool?, clipboard], which already retries Clipboard last; the removed Err arm retried the same Clipboard backend after Auto already failed it, and Type/Paste never hit it. Required state: single all-backends-failed path reporting 'Saved — run: cantrip last'. Evidence: inject.rs backend_order always appends Clipboard for Auto; grep shows no remaining allows_clipboard_fallback callers; ./scripts/check passed fmt, clippy -D warnings, and cargo test (110 tests). SHA is a descendant of origin/master (fast-forward confirmed).
